title: The bamboo cloud pavilion
alt: A woven bamboo pavilion casts intricate shadows across a circular stone plaza.
description: A contemporary architectural scene emphasizes continuous structure, dense lattice work and dappled light.
prompt: A spectacular architectural photograph of a public pavilion woven from pale bamboo strips. Several continuous arching structural ribs support a dense lattice roof shaped like a soft cloud, with open passages beneath and a circular stone plaza. The bamboo ribs meet the ground through visible coherent supports; no floating roof elements. Dappled sunlight reveals thousands of woven intersections, a calm green park surrounds the plaza, no people or lettering, refined contemporary architecture.
